name: vllm-mori121
about: The validated v1.2.1 (mori121) disaggregated stack: MoRI v1.2.1, AITER 0.1.16.post3 wheel, the Wide-EP WRITE-mode vLLM branch of 06/29, vllm-router, and (default) the rixl transport stack.

mori.why: EP/RDMA correctness fixes and the ROCm 7.2.3 dma-buf registration path the connector .env relies on. Built with BUILD_UMBP=OFF and the default NIC backends (disabling them deadlocked the cross-node EP all-to-all init).

vllm.why: Wide-EP multi-pod PD WRITE mode with the MoRIIO disagg fixes (#39276 notify, #41751 LL split, DP-rank hash-failsafe) native. Branch tip on 2026-11-03 (last commit 2026-06-26). Personal fork until the fixes are upstream.

router.why: vllm-router with DP-rank round-robin (11841c0d) and the 2P2D KV-notify fix (remote_dp_rank_override + remote_dp_size); without the latter 2P2D EP=16 wedges with 'remote blocks never arrived'. Personal fork until vllm-project/router PR #181 lands.

transports.why: UCX + RIXL (+python) + rocSHMEM + DeepEP for the rixl connector (NIXL TP, DeepEP wideEP). Off builds a MoRI-EP-only image.

rocshmem.why: Parent of rocm-systems 16dc5673 (2026-09-25), whose scoped float/double atomics this ROCm 7.2 compiler rejects; the rocSHMEM these images last built with.

deepep.why: the legacy images cloned the default branch with no ref; its tip on 2026-11-03 (last commit 2026-06-30)
